title: Small Grays and a tall Gray during Mario Woods's abduction
summary: Mario Woods tells of Small Grays and a tall Gray during Mario Woods's abduction, about 1960s at On board a craft, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: On board a craft, South Dakota

tellings.quote: they look like Grays they look like the small Grays but the one behind them I guess you would classify him as a tall gray on Whitley streer book communion

plain: A man named Mario Woods says that in the 1960s in South Dakota he was taken on board a craft. He describes beings that looked like "Grays", the familiar small, gray-skinned aliens with large heads and eyes, and behind them a taller one, which he compares to the beings in Communion, a well-known book by the writer Whitley Strieber about his own encounters. If true, it would be a first-hand account of being abducted by non-human beings.
